snippet.title: Mouseward - Official Demo Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase May 2026
snippet.description:
Take up your sword and uncover the secrets of a cursed kingdom in this soulslike collectathon. Awaken as a Royal Mouse Guard, master combat, defeat foes and search for celestial fragments to restore a once great kingdom.
Mouseward will be available on PC, and a demo is out now on Steam.
